description_en: Queries the details of a specified VPN gateway
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnGateway接口查询指定VPN网关的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1r3v1xqkl0w519g0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnGateway

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:

false (default): does not include pending order data.

true: includes pending order data
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含未生效的订单数据。取值：

false（默认值）：不包含未生效的订单数据。

true：包含未生效的订单数据

AutoPropagate.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic propagation is enabled for the VPN gateway. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
AutoPropagate.description_zh:
是否已开启VPN网关的路由自动传播功能。取值：

true：已开启。

false：未开启

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The payment status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.

FinancialLocked: locked due to overdue payment
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
VPN网关的付费状态。取值：

Normal：正常。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Value:

<props="partner">POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go billing method.</props>

<props="china">Prepay: subscription.</props>
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型。仅取值：

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the VPN gateway was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp follows the UNIX time format, which represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建VPN网关的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建VPN网关时的总时长

Description.description_en: The description of the VPN gateway

DisasterRecoveryInternetIp.description_en:
The second IP address assigned by the system to the VPN gateway instance for creating IPsec-VPN connections.

This parameter is returned only for VPN gateway instances that support creating dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
DisasterRecoveryInternetIp.description_zh:
系统为VPN网关实例分配的用于创建IPsec-VPN连接的第二个IP地址。

仅支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回当前参数

DisasterRecoveryVSwitchId.description_en:
The ID of the second vSwitch associated with the VPN gateway instance.

This parameter is returned only for VPN gateway instances that support creating dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
DisasterRecoveryVSwitchId.description_zh:
VPN网关实例关联的第二个交换机ID。

仅支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回当前参数

EnableBgp.description_en:
The enabling status of the BGP feature for the VPN gateway. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
EnableBgp.description_zh:
VPN网关BGP功能的开启状态。取值：

true：已开启。

false：未开启

EndTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the VPN gateway expires. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp follows the UNIX time format, which represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
VPN网关到期时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至VPN网关到期时的总时长

GatewayType.description_en:
The type of the VPN gateway. Valid values:
Traditional: traditional VPN gateway that supports both IPsec and SSL features.
Enhanced.SiteToSite: enhanced site-to-cloud VPN gateway that supports only the IPsec feature
GatewayType.description_zh:
VPN 网关类型，取值：
Traditional：传统型VPN网关，覆盖IPSec功能和SSL功能
Enhanced.SiteToSite：增强型站点入云VPN，只覆盖IPSec功能

InternetIp.description_en:
If the VPN gateway instance supports creating single-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, this address is the IP address of the VPN gateway instance and can be used to create IPsec-VPN connections or SSL-VPN connections.

If the VPN gateway instance supports creating dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, this address is the first IP address used to create IPsec-VPN connections and cannot be used to create SSL-VPN connections.

    If the VPN gateway instance supports creating dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, the system assigns two IPsec IP addresses to the VPN gateway instance for creating dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
InternetIp.description_zh:
在VPN网关实例支持创建单隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的场景下，该地址为VPN网关实例的IP地址，可用于创建IPsec-VPN连接或SSL-VPN连接。

在VPN网关实例支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的场景下，该地址为用于创建IPsec-VPN连接的第一个IP地址，不能用于创建SSL-VPN连接。

    在VPN网关实例支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的场景下，系统会为VPN网关实例分配两个IPsec地址，用于创建双隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接

IpsecVpn.description_en:
Indicates whether IPsec-VPN is enabled. Valid values:

enable: enabled.

disable: disabled
IpsecVpn.description_zh:
是否开启了IPsec-VPN功能。取值：

enable：已开启。

disable：未开启

Name.description_en: The name of the VPN gateway

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the VPN gateway.

public: public VPN gateway.
private: private VPN gateway
NetworkType.description_zh:
VPN网关的网络类型。

public：公网VPN网关。
private：私网VPN网关

ReservationData.description_en:
The pending order data.

This parameter is returned only when IncludeReservationData is set to true
ReservationData.description_zh:
未生效的订单数据。

仅IncludeReservationData传入true才会返回该组参数

ReservationEndTime.description_en:
If the pending order type is TEMP_UPGRADE (temporary upgrade), this parameter indicates the revert time for the temporary upgrade.

If the pending order type is RENEWCHANGE (renewal with specification change) or RENEW (renewal), this parameter indicates the effective period when the renewal or renewal with specification change takes effect
ReservationEndTime.description_zh:
如果未生效订单类型为TEMP_UPGRADE（临时升配）时，该参数表示为临时升配的还原时间。

如果未生效订单类型为RENEWCHANGE（续费变配）或RENEW（续费）时，该参数表示为续费或续费变配开始生效时间

ReservationIpsec.description_en:
The enabling status of the IPsec-VPN feature for the pending order. Valid values:

enable: enabled.

disable: disabled
ReservationIpsec.description_zh:
未生效订单IPsec-VPN功能开启状态。取值：

enable：已开启。

disable：未开启

ReservationMaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent SSL-VPN connections of the pending order
ReservationMaxConnections.description_zh: 未生效订单SSL-VPN并发连接用户数的规格

ReservationOrderType.description_en:
The type of the pending order. Valid values:

RENEWCHANGE: renewal with specification change.

TEMP_UPGRADE: temporary upgrade.

RENEW: renewal
ReservationOrderType.description_zh:
未生效订单类型。取值：

RENEWCHANGE：续费变配。

TEMP_UPGRADE：临时升配。

RENEW：续费

ReservationSpec.description_en: The bandwidth specification of the pending order. Unit: Mbit/s
ReservationSpec.description_zh: 未生效订单的带宽规格。单位：Mbps

ReservationSsl.description_en:
The enabling status of the SSL-VPN feature for the pending order. Valid values:

enable: enabled.

disable: disabled
ReservationSsl.description_zh:
未生效订单SSL-VPN功能开启状态。取值：

enable：已开启。

disable：未开启

Status.description_en:
The status of the pending order. Valid values:

1: the renewal or renewal with specification change order has not taken effect.

2: the temporary upgrade order has taken effect. After the restoration time is reached, the system restores the VPN gateway to the specification before the temporary upgrade. In this case, ReservationIpsec, ReservationMaxConnections, ReservationSpec, and ReservationSsl indicate the specifications before the temporary upgrade
Status.description_zh:
未生效订单状态。取值：

1：表示续费或续费变配的订单未生效。

2：表示临时升配的订单已生效。在到达还原时间后，系统会将VPN网关规格恢复到临时升配前的规格。此时ReservationIpsec、ReservationMaxConnections、ReservationSpec、ReservationSsl表示为VPN网关临时升配前的规格

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the VPN gateway belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
VPN网关所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

Spec.description_en: The bandwidth specification of the VPN gateway. Unit: Mbit/s

SslMaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent SSL-VPN connections
SslMaxConnections.description_zh: SSL-VPN并发连接用户数的规格

SslVpn.description_en:
The enabling status of the SSL-VPN feature. Valid values:

enable: enabled.

disable: disabled
SslVpn.description_zh:
SSL-VPN功能的开启状态。取值：

enable：已开启。

SslVpnInternetIp.description_en:
The IP address for SSL-VPN connections.

This parameter is returned only when the SSL-VPN feature is enabled on a VPN gateway instance that has a public network type and supports creating dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections
SslVpnInternetIp.description_zh:
SSL-VPN连接的IP地址。

仅支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的公网网络类型的VPN网关实例开启SSL-VPN功能后，才会返回当前参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

init: initializing.

provisioning: preparing.

active: Normal.

updating: updating.

deleting: deleting
Status.description_zh:
VPN网关的状态。取值：

init：初始化。

provisioning：准备中。

active：正常。

updating：更新中。

deleting：删除中

Tag.description_en:
The system-generated labels of the VPN gateway.

VpnEnableBgp: indicates whether the VPN gateway supports the BGP feature.
    - true: supported.
    - false: not supported.
VisuallySsl: indicates whether the VPN gateway supports viewing SSL client connection information.
    - true: supported.
    - false: not supported.
PbrPriority: indicates whether the VPN gateway supports configuring policy priority for policy-based routing.
    - true: supported.
    - false: not supported.
VpnNewImage: indicates whether the VPN gateway is a new-generation VPN gateway.
    - true: yes.
    - false: no.
description: the description of the VPN gateway, which is used only for internal system purposes.
VpnVersion: the version number of the VPN gateway.
IDaaSNewVersion: indicates whether the VPN gateway supports attaching to an EIAM 2.0 instance.
    - true: supported.
    - false: not supported
Tag.description_zh:
系统自动生成的VPN网关标签。

VpnEnableBgp：表示VPN网关是否支持BGP功能。
    - true：支持。
    - false：不支持。
VisuallySsl：表示VPN网关是否支持查看SSL客户端的连接信息。
    - true：支持。
    - false：不支持。
PbrPriority：表示VPN网关是否支持为策略路由配置策略优先级。
    - true：支持。
    - false：不支持。
VpnNewImage：表示VPN网关是否为新型VPN网关。
    - true：是。
    - false：否。
description：表示VPN网关的描述信息，仅供系统内部使用。
VpnVersion：表示VPN网关的版本号。
IDaaSNewVersion：表示VPN网关是否支持绑定EIAM 2.0实例。
    - true：支持。
    - false：不支持
